Where can I find your full shipping policy?

You can review our full shipping policy by visiting our Shipping Policy page: Shipping Policy.

Here are some highlights:

During checkout, you can select your preferred delivery timeframe using our delivery calendar. Available dates are tailored to your area and planting season.
US customers select an estimated arrival date; Canadian customers select a ship week.
If you use an express payment method like Shop Pay, the system assigns an estimated arrival date automatically, which will be shown in your order confirmation email.
Roses are shipped in one-gallon containers (compostable or plastic), perennials in plastic containers, and bulbs in burlap bags.
You'll receive tracking information once your package is shipped.

Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We currently ship within the contiguous United States, with select products available for shipping to Alaska, Hawaii, and limited regions in Canada. We do not ship to other international locations at this time.

If you are ordering to Canada, all customs duties and necessary certifications are already included in your shipping charges—there are no additional fees for customs or duties on your end.
